issues.prechangeEvidence: Hypergraph mode returned V2V NOT_REQUESTED, v2vEdges was empty, and the only topology spring loop therefore performed zero topology work.
issues.postchangeEvidence: Force consumes the Stage 3 incidence index and applies centroid attraction once per incidence in O(I); deterministic disconnected/overlap tests and oracle HG713-R01 pass.

issues.prechangeEvidence: Hypergraph mode rendered zero co-membership lines because its only visual line source was the unrequested analytical V2V projection.
issues.postchangeEvidence: A dedicated deterministic visual co-membership overlay is complete when affordable and fair-share sampled when bounded, with user-visible status.

issues.prechangeEvidence: The Force tick was guarded by verts.length <= 700; 701+ silently stopped while Reheat only changed alpha.
issues.postchangeEvidence: Exact pairwise repulsion is selected through 700 and deterministic 24-sample-per-vertex approximation from 701 upward. All 699/700/701/702/1000 fixtures move finite positions and Reheat restores alpha.

issues.prechangeEvidence: Every computed analytical Line Graph edge was drawn on every frame and draw unconditionally scheduled another RAF forever.
issues.postchangeEvidence: Preview renders at most 4,000 deterministic Line Graph edges, preserves the exact analytical/export result, communicates LOD, and stops RAF when idle.
issues.deferred: Permitted Stage 4 analytical projection construction still runs synchronously on the main thread; worker/cancellation architecture remains Stage 7 scope.

issues.prechangeEvidence: Truthiness guards suppressed weight 0 in ring hover, selected metadata, and the hyperedge list.
issues.postchangeEvidence: Semantic presence checks display weight 0 and negative values while preserving the existing weight-1/null policy.

issues.prechangeEvidence: Mouse-down tested vertices only; any non-node click started pan and cleared selection even though rings were advertised as clickable.
issues.postchangeEvidence: Pointer priority is vertex, then shared-geometry ring perimeter, then empty-canvas pan/clear. Nearest perimeter, smaller ring, then display order resolves overlap.

issues.prechangeEvidence: find(...) || find(...) converted an exact numeric 0 result into a false-negative.
issues.postchangeEvidence: Search uses explicit undefined detection; numeric/canonical zero resolves and renders through explicit null-state checks.

issues.prechangeEvidence: Stage 1 had already moved Viz position state to createGraphIdentifierMap()/Map access; no unsafe position object remained.
issues.postchangeEvidence: Initialization, merge, lookup, Force, hit testing, drag, hover, search, and selection remain Map-backed; prototype-like IDs pass unit, DOM, Stage 1, and oracle gates.

issues.prechangeEvidence: Canvas used offsetWidth plus fixed height during effect setup and had no ResizeObserver, leaving backing dimensions stale after container resize.
issues.postchangeEvidence: ResizeObserver drives independent CSS/backing sizes, DPR 1/2 tests pass, DPR is capped at 3, and resize preserves positions, transform, selection, search, and Force energy.

issues.prechangeEvidence: Explicit selV/searchHit != null checks already distinguished unset null from literal identifier "null".
issues.postchangeEvidence: Empty search returns unset null; query/selection "null" remains an exact graph identifier in pure and DOM tests.
